offers_products.reason: Makes Cessna and Beechcraft aircraft, Bell helicopters, E-Z-GO vehicles, Jacobsen turf equipment, Kautex fuel systems and defense vehicles.

offers_services.reason: Revenue is mainly from manufactured aircraft, vehicles and systems; aftermarket service and the Finance segment are smaller parts.

sells_to_consumers.reason: E-Z-GO golf and utility vehicles and Cessna and Beechcraft aircraft reach individual owners, though many buyers are businesses.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Bell and Textron Systems sell to the U.S. military and governments; Kautex sells to automakers; Cessna sells to operators.

recurring_revenue.reason: Most revenue is from one-off sales of aircraft, helicopters, vehicles and defense programs; aftermarket parts are a minority.

cyclical_demand.reason: Business jets, golf carts, turf equipment and automotive fuel systems are deferrable purchases, though defense is steadier.

big_ticket.reason: Aircraft, helicopters, armored vehicles and ships are large, infrequent purchases for buyers.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for manufactured aircraft, vehicles and systems, not for staff time.

large_customers.reason: U.S. Navy and Army, foreign air forces, automakers and large fleet operators are main customers for Bell, Systems and Kautex.

asset_heavy.reason: Runs heavy manufacturing plants, shipyards and aircraft production lines, plus a captive finance arm, all needing ongoing capital investment.

notes: Multi-industry conglomerate; the aviation and defense product segments are the larger part, so answers lean that way.
